README for ffc.h v26.03.2

----------------------------------------------

We're using the ffc.h library[1] in our (compiled-in)
floating-point fast_float_strtod implementation for faster and more
portable parsing of 64 decimal strings.

The single file ffc.h is an amalgamation of the entire library,
which is available as a release artifact from the ffc.h repository[1]

[1]: https://github.com/kolemannix/ffc.h
